relationships.name: MemberOf
relationships.cardinality: A player belongs to one team (no trades).

relationships.name: PlayingHome
relationships.cardinality: A game has a home team; a team can play repeatedly.

relationships.name: PlayingAway
relationships.cardinality: A game has an away team; a team can play repeatedly.

relationships.name: OccurIn
relationships.cardinality: A play occurs in one game.

relationships.name: ParticipateIn
relationships.cardinality: A play has one or more player participants.

diagram.notes: A play is a run by one player or a pass involving a passer and receiver. The source does not specify all participation cardinalities; confirm whether a play has exactly one runner or one passer and one receiver.
